full_text: Local government units shall appropriate in their respective annual budgets such amounts as are sufficient to pay the loans and other indebtedness incurred or redeem or retire bonds, debentures, securities, notes and other obligations issued under this Title: Provided, That failure to provide the appropriations herein required shall render their annual budgets inoperative. TITLE FIVE. - LOCAL FISCAL ADMINISTRATION CHAPTER 1 - GENERAL PROVISIONS
